name: Position Effect 3 Code
definition: Specifies the order in which events are processed.

FIFO.name: Fifo
FIFO.definition: First in, first out. Results in a position obtained after having sold in priority the securities bought chronologically.

LIFO.name: Lifo
LIFO.definition: Last in, last out. Results in a position obtained after having sold in priority the securities bought chronologically.
